svg.title: SMC reset distribution
svg.desc: Reset distribution inside the SMC. Boundary inputs enter on the left. u_smc_reset_unit, in u_smc_peripherals, builds rst_primary_smc_clk_no, rst_primary_periph_clk_no, rst_warm_smc_clk_no and rst_cold_stable_smc_clk_no from powergood_i, rst_cold_ni, rst_cool_n_from_pin_i, sep_wdt_reset_n_i, cfg_flr_pf_active_i, the JTAG overrides and fuse_reset_n, which u_smc_efuse_wrapper releases once fuse sensing completes and any boot stall ends. rst_primary_smc_clk_no resets u_smc_base, most of u_smc_peripherals, the CPU_CTRL registers in u_smc_cpu_ctrl_wrap, the front-port demux and the cluster AXI isolates. rst_primary_periph_clk_no resets the I2C, UART, I3C and AVSBus register logic and the peripheral-clock side of u_smc_peripherals_cdc. rst_warm_smc_clk_no resets the core and uncore reset outputs of u_smc_cpu_ctrl_wrap and the warm scratch register. rst_cold_stable_smc_clk_no resets u_ext_boot_seq_done_qual and disables the GPIO outputs. fuse_reset_n resets the scratch RAM zero-fill sequencer. u_smc_cpu_ctrl_wrap drives cluster_uncore_reset_n, which resets the uncore of u_digital_top including the four watchdogs and, through rom_domain, u_tilelink_to_rom_memory_convert, and the cluster boundary isolation delay and cluster_ded_o flops in u_smc_cpu, core_reset_n[3:0], which, ANDed with zero-fill completion and the inverted debug hart reset request, resets each Rocket tile, and debug_reset_n, which resets the debug module. The gated core reset reaches each watchdog's wdt_n_corerst only as a count-enable gate, not as a reset. smc_cpu_jtag_reset_i resets the debug transport module and rst_telemetry_ni the telemetry side of u_telemetry_receiver_wrap.
